Import Data (Raw Material)

Roll IN + Roll Out + DO (Full Workbook — upload sekali je)

Ada data lama dalam Google Sheet/Excel? Upload je terus keseluruhan file (semua tab sekali) di sini — sistem akan cari tab "Roll IN", "Roll Out" dan "DO" sendiri dan import ketiga-tiganya sekali gus, ikut turutan yang betul. Tak payah upload berasingan-asingan lagi.
⬆
...or drag & drop a .csv / .xlsx file here
Boleh upload 1 file .xlsx yang ada banyak tab (macam Google Sheet awak — download as .xlsx dari File → Download). Sistem baca tab yang namanya ada "Roll IN", "Roll Out" dan "DO" (atau "Delivery Order") secara automatik. Tab lain (STO Items, Balance, Users) diabaikan — tak perlu buang. Column dalam tab Roll IN: Fabric Name, Fabric Code, GSM, Color Code, Color Name, Roll No., Meter, Date, Staff, Timestamp, Batch, Invoice No., Notes. Tab Roll Out: Fabric Name, Fabric Code, Color Code, Color Name, Roll No., Meter, Date, Staff, Timestamp, Notes, Destination, STO No., Status. Tab DO: STO No., DO No., Date, Notes.

...or drag & drop a .csv / .xlsx file here

Create STO / Roll Out History Only

Untuk upload tab "Roll Out" bersendirian (satu file, satu tab) — kalau file penuh (banyak tab) dah diupload atas, tak perlu guna ni lagi.
⬆
...or drag & drop a .csv / .xlsx file here
Columns (same order as a typical Roll Out sheet): Fabric Name, Fabric Code, Color Code, Color Name, Roll No., Meter, Date, Staff, Timestamp (ignored), Notes, Destination, STO No., Status (optional — defaults to Completed).

Delivery Order (DO) History Only

Untuk simpan rekod DO lama supaya boleh cari/reprint balik nanti. Import STO/Roll Out history dulu (atas) — sistem ambil senarai roll & destinasi terus dari STO No. yang dah wujud, awak cuma perlu bagi DO No. dia.
⬆
...or drag & drop a .csv / .xlsx file here
Columns: STO No. (must already exist from the import above), DO No., Date (optional — defaults to the STO's date), Notes (optional). One row per DO — STO No. yang dah ada DO sebelum ni akan dilangkau (tak duplicate).

SLA Settings

Email Auto-Send Setup (EmailJS)

Lets "Out of Delivery" and the per-destination ✉️ button in Trip Details send an email straight away, with no extra click needed — using a free EmailJS account connected to your own Gmail. One-time setup:

1. Go to emailjs.com and sign up free.
2. Email Services → Add New Service → connect your Gmail → copy the Service ID.
3. Email Templates → Create New Template. Set "To Email" field to {{to_email}}, "Subject" to {{subject}}, and put {{message}} somewhere in the body → copy the Template ID.
4. Account → General → copy your Public Key.
5. Paste all three below and Save.

Delivery Status

Every DO that's reached "DO Issued" on the Progress Board, tracked across its full journey: "DO Issued" (printed, no trip/driver yet), "Scheduled" (trip + driver assigned, not dispatched), "Out of Delivery" (driver already left), or "Delivered" (Completed) under Operation Fleet -> Trip Schedule. Once a DO is dispatched it moves out of the "DO Issued" column on the Progress Board and is tracked here instead. This is a read-only record; nothing here can be dragged or edited.

Daily Targets (Overall)

OFF (default) = hari-hari biasa, tak campaign — ikut kuantiti Order sahaja, semua target di bawah disembunyikan. ON = target campaign di bawah aktif; nombor yang disimpan akan kembali automatik bila ON semula, tak perlu taip semula.
Weekday (Mon–Fri)
Weekend (Sat–Sun)
Separate targets for weekday vs weekend — the dashboards automatically use whichever applies to today. Separate from the individual picker/station targets below. Leave a field blank to hide that donut on that day.
Unsaved changes — click Save before leaving this tab.

Pickers

Type any name and click "+ Add Picker" — handy for part-time staff not on the Staff Schedule roster. Active staff tagged Role = Picker on that roster auto-register here too (no need to add them manually), and also show up as suggestions while typing. Registered pickers show up as a dropdown when assigning picker(s) to an STO — no need to type names each time. Target is auto-calculated and shift-aware: the overall Picker Daily Target above (Weekday/Weekend) is split across whoever shares that picker's shift TODAY on the Staff Schedule tab (Day headcount for Day shift, Night headcount for Night shift) — it reflows automatically each day as staff go on/off Day, Night, Off, or Leave. A picker shows "—" for target on any day they're Normal (the default — a regular working day with no special campaign shift), Off, or on Leave, or until they're added to Staff Schedule with Role = Picker (see "Shift Today" column). "Today (pcs)" counts pieces from STOs assigned to that picker today and resets to 0 automatically the next day.
Unsaved changes — click Save before leaving this tab.

Rollcages / Trolleys

Registered rollcages show up as a dropdown when an STO is dragged into Packing. Each one can only be assigned to one STO at a time — it frees up automatically once that STO moves on to Packed (or gets dragged back out of Packing).
Unsaved changes — click Save before leaving this tab.

Packing Stations

Registered stations are used to auto-assign STOs when they enter the Packing stage — each STO rotates to the next station in the list (round-robin). You can still change a card's station manually afterward. Target is auto-calculated: the overall Packer Daily Target above (Weekday/Weekend) is split evenly across only the stations currently ON — an OFF station shows "—" and doesn't shrink everyone else's share. "Today (pcs)" counts only pieces assigned to that station today and resets to 0 automatically the next day. By default (Auto) a station is ON only while someone actually has it picked as "This Device's Station" (sidebar), and auto-flips back OFF ~15 min after that device goes quiet (closes the tab, loses power, etc.) without anyone explicitly switching stations. Click the Status button to cycle Auto → Force ON → Force OFF → back to Auto — forcing it either way overrides device presence completely, for whenever you need full manual control. Name a station with "Day" or "Night" in it (e.g. "Day Shift Packer") and its Manpower auto-fills live from the Staff Schedule tab — every Active staff tagged Role = Packer and on that shift today, no typing needed; stations named any other way keep the freehand Manpower field.
Unsaved changes — click Save before leaving this tab.

Receive Stations

Registered stations show up when assigning who's receiving an incoming STO (dragging a card into "On Progress" on the Inbound Progress Board). Target is auto-calculated: the overall Inbound Daily Target above (Weekday/Weekend) is split evenly across only the stations currently ON — an OFF station shows "—" and doesn't shrink everyone else's share. "Today (pcs)" counts only pieces that finished receiving (moved to Complete) at that station today and resets to 0 automatically the next day. By default (Auto) a station is ON only while someone actually has it picked as "This Device's Station" (sidebar), and auto-flips back OFF ~15 min after that device goes quiet (closes the tab, loses power, etc.) without anyone explicitly switching stations. Click the Status button to cycle Auto → Force ON → Force OFF → back to Auto — forcing it either way overrides device presence completely, for whenever you need full manual control. Name a station with "Day" or "Night" in it (e.g. "Day Shift Receiver") and its Manpower auto-fills live from the Staff Schedule tab — every Active staff tagged Role = Receiver and on that shift today, no typing needed; stations named any other way keep the freehand Manpower field.
Unsaved changes — click Save before leaving this tab.

Drivers

Drivers are their own list here — independent of the Staff Schedule roster. Type a name and click "+ Add Driver". Registered drivers show up as autocomplete suggestions when creating a new trip under Operation Fleet.
Unsaved changes — click Save before leaving this tab.

Printers

Registered printers show up as a dropdown in the Price Tag Checklist, under Raw Material.

Admin Password (Operation Fleet)

Once a trip's date is in the past, it becomes a locked log — editing it (moving its card, changing driver/destination/DO, plate no., deleting it, or scheduling a brand-new trip for that day) needs this Admin password first. Leave this blank to leave past dates unlocked (no change from before). This is a soft lock stored in this browser only, same as driver passwords — not real server-side security.

Users & Access (Login)

Each staff logs in with their own username & password, and only sees the tabs you tick for them below. Admin/Team Lead accounts always have full access to everything, including this page. Within Team Setup, "Admin & Access" (this page — Admin Password, Users, Cloud Sync) always stays Admin/Team Lead-only no matter what — it's not one of the toggle-able tabs. The other Team Setup pages (Daily Targets, Pickers, Rollcages / Trolleys, Packing Stations, Receive Stations, Drivers) CAN be individually granted below, same as any other tab. This login is stored in this browser only, same as the other passwords in this app — a soft access-control layer, not real server-side security.

Cloud Sync (Firebase)

Every staff's computer shares the same STO/DO/Fleet/Inbound/Users/settings data automatically through one shared Firebase database — no setup needed per computer, it just connects on its own. Changes made on any computer show up on the others within about a second.

Weekly Schedule

Click a cell to cycle Normal → Day Shift → Night Shift → Off → On Leave. Normal (the default, blank cell) means a regular working day with no special campaign shift — Off means an actual day off/not working. Shift rotates independently every week — each week is set separately, so a campaign rotation just means paging forward and clicking through. Who's PIC/Backup PIC is set on the Staff Roster above (Role column), not here.

Garment Order

Import batches/SKUs straight from Excel or CSV instead of adding one by one.
⬆
...or drag & drop a .csv / .xlsx file here
Columns: Batch No., Garment Name, SKU, Category (adult/kids/baby/merchandise/accessories), then one column per size — fill in the quantity under whichever size(s) were ordered. Adult uses row 1's headers (XS-6XL); Kids/Baby use row 2's headers (12-18 Month to 12-13 Years). Each filled size becomes its own line item named "SKU-Size". Merchandise/Accessories have no sizes — just put the quantity in the first size column (E) and the line item is named the SKU as-is. Order No. is auto-generated as "Batch No.-Garment Name-YYYYMMDD"; same Batch No. + Garment Name on the same day groups into one batch card.
...or add a batch one at a time:
Order No. is auto-generated ("Batch No.-Garment Name-YYYYMMDD"). Pick a Category to open its size boxes, fill in whichever apply — you can reopen the card later to add more SKUs/sizes.

Inbound Progress Board

Drag a card to move it between Active, On Progress, and Complete.

Putaway

Rollcages/trolleys with items waiting to be put away — from Garment Order receiving. Click "Putaway Done" once EVERYTHING's been placed on the rack, or click a SKU tile itself once just that SKU is done — it turns green. Once every SKU is confirmed this way, the rollcage frees up automatically.

STO From Boutique Alert Thresholds

Applies to every boutique the same way — no per-boutique setup. An STO From Boutique turns Warning once it's waited this many days since being issued, and Critical once it passes the second number. Changes apply immediately.

Garment Order Alert Thresholds

Separate from STO From Boutique above. A batch turns Warning/Critical based on days since its Order Date, and stops counting (shows "Done") once every SKU inside it is fully received. Changes apply immediately.

Generate Shipping Label

Printing will generate one label per carton, numbered 1 up to Total Carton — not just the carton shown in the preview above. Once an STO is printed, Total Carton locks so labels stay consistent; you can still reprint and correct other details.
